comparison.objective: Empty a robot-vacuum dustbin into a waste box, reseat it, and close its doors; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a bin while pressing a door release, control granular discharge, and replace the bin versus precision two-tool threaded adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: At least nine dust balls captured, bin reseated with doors shut, and arms returned; partial credit follows delivered quantity.
comparison.reason: Triggered dumping and reseating a container are unrelated to coupled screw/jam-nut calibration and retained cycling.
